evidence: Aggregate values transcribed from the supplied research report; raw predictions and metric output tables were not supplied.

primary_result.aggregation: Mean of functional-category means after grouping assays by UniProt and functional category.

non_binding_204.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-assay Spearman; distinct from the primary grouped metric.

historical_local_comparisons.baseline_source: Local reevaluation of the authors released s2f.pth; temporary loading patch not fully preserved.

limitations: ProteinGym subset labels informed method selection, and full-204 results were inspected during development.
The structure checkpoint was locally trained, not the original authors released checkpoint.
The method combines multiple language models and MSA information.
Some assays and functional-category means declined.
The archive does not establish overall ProteinGym SOTA, leaderboard inclusion, or a global rank.
Checkpoint, data, reference CSVs, per-mutation predictions, caches, and run logs are external.
The portable launcher was checked on four representative assays according to the source report, not rerun on all 217.
